title: Defining and cataloging variants in pangenome graphs
authors: Pouria Salehi Nowbandegani, Shenghan Zhang, Haoyang Hu, Heng Li, Luke J. O’Connor
abstract: Salehi Nowbandegani et al. introduce pantree, a framework for defining variants in pangenome graphs. By choosing a reference tree and cataloging non-tree edges, pantree resolves variants embedded in non-GRCh38 sequences and produces a genome-wide VCF catalog.
